label: Dreischulte 43: warfarin with ribavirin
title: Warfarin with ribavirin
statement: Patient treated with warfarin - is co-prescribed ribavirin

plain_summary: Warfarin response may change during hepatitis C treatment that includes ribavirin. The direction of an INR change cannot be predicted from the two supplies.
rule_for_models: Suspect concurrent treatment at any age when warfarin and ribavirin supply dates overlap or fall within 60 days of each other. Use the quantity, directions and any recorded hold or stop to exclude courses that did not overlap. If the dates fall within 60 days and unclear directions leave overlap uncertain, report only a possible finding. Ask for the daily dose and whether the two medicines were taken at the same time. Cite a supply of each medicine even if there is no INR result.
cannot_be_seen: Supply lines cannot confirm which doses were taken, medicines supplied elsewhere, the INR response or a bleeding or clotting event.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm why ribavirin is being used and which other medicines are in the regimen? Could we review the recent INR results and the monitoring plan during treatment and after it ends?
